mei: FYI - just kicked off a quick smoke on pavo-v2:q4a in canary and we got locale-specific detokenization/regression signals. Looks like several scripts affected: CJK numeral spacing (zh), furigana detach (ja), jamo spacing (ko), and an RTL bracket/parenthesis orientation issue for ar. Repro notes and small examples below.

ops-bot: deploy canary pavo-v2:q4a -> canary-pool-7 started (id: canary-5590) :rocket:

mei: Short failing examples from the smoke suite (inputs are small):
- zh input: 我付了壹佰贰拾叁元整
  baseline (float): I paid one hundred twenty-three yuan exactly.
  pavo-v2:q4a (canary): 我付了 壹 佰 贰 拾 叁 元 整  -> spaces inserted inside the formal numeral span, detok produces odd spacing in final output.

- ja input: 学校に小さな花(ふりがな)
  baseline (float): At school a small flower (furigana).
  pavo-v2:q4a: 学校に小さな花  ( ふ り が な )  -> furigana parentheses separated and inner kana spaced out, likely token boundary misalignment.

- ko input: 가격은일백이십삼원입니다
  baseline: The price is one hundred twenty-three won.
  pavo-v2:q4a: 가격은 일 백 이 십 삼 원 입니다  -> jamo/syllable grouping broken into spaced tokens.

- ar input: مرحبا (أحمد)
  baseline: Hello (Ahmed)
  pavo-v2:q4a: ( مرحبا أحمد )  -> parentheses order and attachment moved; punctuation sits oddly after bracket.

mei: Repro command I used against canary: 
```
python infra/eval_runner.py --model pavo-v2:q4a --suite multilingual/quick_locale_smoke --samples 300 --canary canary-5590
```

eval-bot: Run summary (multilingual/quick_locale_smoke, 300 samples):
- zh->en BLEU: baseline 33.2 -> canary 29.6 (delta -3.6)
- ja->en BLEU: baseline 31.0 -> canary 28.4 (delta -2.6)
- ko->en BLEU: baseline 30.5 -> canary 27.8 (delta -2.7)
- ar->en BLEU: baseline 28.9 -> canary 24.7 (delta -4.2)
- zh numeral split rate: baseline 1.1% -> canary 9.7%
- ja furigana detach rate: baseline 0.6% -> canary 5.2%
- ko syllable merge failures: baseline 0.9% -> canary 6.4%
- ar bracket/orientation failures: baseline 0.4% -> canary 5.9%

sam: Thanks. Quick hypothesis: fast tokenizer binary or trie indexing is resolving prefixes differently after q4 quant artifacts were generated. If the tokenizer binary shipped inside the wheel has an offset change in the vocab mapping, that would explain per-language boundary shifts. Could also be normalization differences (NFKC vs NFC) if a normalization table got swapped.

ravi: Can we confirm tokenization with both fast and python fallback tokenizers? Also, check if model artifact contains an embedded vocab file or if we rely on the runtime wheel's vocab. If embedded, quant pipeline could've miswritten the vocab remap table. @eng-infra can you snapshot the canary container and upload tokenizer load logs + sha of vocab file?

mei: I ran local encodes: python fallback tokenizer preserves spans across all four examples. Fast-tokenizer shows the injected space tokens and split grapheme sequences. Dumped a short token window for the zh case (fast):
```
# fast token window around '壹佰贰拾叁'
['我','付','了','壹',' ', '佰',' ', '贰',' ', '拾',' ', '叁','元']
# ids: [331, 4412, 12, 90021, 5, 12034, 5, 67890, 5, 23456, 5, 345]
```

ciara: I'm starting a local bisect of the quant artifact chain. Early signal: q8 and q7 artifacts behave like baseline; q6 shows tiny breakage on ja only; q5 introduces intermittent zh splits; q4 reproduces consistently across languages. I'll upload the per-version token dumps to s3://redwood-ci/orbis-pavo-bisect/ when ready.

sam: If the regression scales with quant aggressiveness, maybe an alphabet remap table is compressed differently in q4 (we used a new integer packing step last week). My task: grep the quant packer for any change that touches the vocab remap or trie serialization. I'll also try a candidate patch to skip the new packing for the trie (fast tokenizer) and re-run q4 quant to see if it helps.

eng-infra: Grabbed the canary logs and attached tokenizer load lines: 
- vocab sha used at startup: sha256:abc123def456...
- tokenizer binary loaded: fasttokenizer.so v1.2.3 (checksum 0x9f3a)
- mounted artifact path: /mnt/models/pavo-v2/q4a/vocab.json (present)
Uploading logs to /tmp/canary-5590-logs.tar.gz

mei: Action items condensed:
- ciara: finish bisect and upload token dumps + per-version BLEU to s3.
- sam: inspect quant packing and attempt patch to avoid trie packing change, run quick q4 rebuild.
- ravi: hold rollback plan and prepare float artifact; request infra to snapshot canary FS for deeper inspection.
- mei: open P0 onboarding ticket with failing sample bundle and runtime eval metrics.

ops-bot: rollback requested -> deploying pavo-v2:float to canary-pool-7 (id pending)

mei: I triggered rollback to float while we investigate. Keeping thread open for bisect links and repro scripts. Thanks all.
